lesson: Capability is not permission; visible tools, provider keys, routes, or orchestration frameworks do not authorize use by themselves.
provenance: class prompt, Mythos provider gate, parallel-dispatch rules, Socrates automation memory
safety_boundary: Require evidence, authority, approval path, and rollback notes before privileged changes.
cheap_verification: Check the next run report and provider-key presence before live execution.

lesson: Record direct versus inferred provenance for every Council teacher before retaining or synthesizing lessons.
provenance: absent local Kiki/Juju/Temporal paths and read-only teacher-agent summaries
safety_boundary: Do not invent persona doctrine when artifacts are absent.
cheap_verification: Inspect agents/kiki, .codex/agents/juju.toml, agents/temporal, and newest automation memory.

lesson: Agent-authored status is lower-trust than verified runtime state and should carry provenance, freshness, and expiry.
provenance: Socrates automation memory and Loki status/admin source patterns
direct_or_inferred: inferred from direct Socrates themes and local Loki evidence
safety_boundary: Do not let accepted or generated status copy imply completed execution or verified authority.
cheap_verification: Look for source, checked_at, expires_at, and state taxonomy fields in future status artifacts.

lesson: Parallel teacher agents may run only with read-only, isolated, non-overlapping scopes.
provenance: godmode:parallel-execution, dispatching-parallel-agents, and this run's teacher scopes
safety_boundary: No concurrent dispatch for shared write targets or exploratory unknowns.
cheap_verification: List each agent scope and write permissions before dispatch.
